tasks.label: Agents: Workspace Startup
tasks.command: if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/scripts/workspace-startup.ps1; else echo 'PowerShell 7 (pwsh) is not installed. Install it from https://aka.ms/powershell, then run .github/scripts/workspace-startup.ps1.'; fi

windows.command: if (Get-Command pwsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/scripts/workspace-startup.ps1 } else { Write-Host 'PowerShell 7 (pwsh) is not installed. Install it from https://aka.ms/powershell, then run .github/scripts/workspace-startup.ps1.' }
